## Why visit

Come for the green tiled room and stay for a local beer and a meal. The former insurance building contains several contrasting drinking spaces, with ceramics and a Victorian pharmacy cabinet providing a memorable setting. This is a useful first or last city-centre stop because it combines visual interest, cask and food close to the main arrival area. Treat the medical memorabilia as part of the pub’s interpretation of Liverpool history; the principal draw for this trip is the unusual room itself.
